acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Cypress UI Coverage https://docs.cypress.io/ui-coverage/get-started/introduction .

Gap: AMAP-V0-007 scores selectors but does not report which interactive elements on a screen no test touches.

Proposal: per-screen counts of interactive elements, tested versus untested, with 'referrers' for untested links. Depends on V1-1162 (template resolution). Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: per-screen interactive-element coverage with referrers for untested links
